title: حفظت النصيحة… متى تطبّقها؟

canvas.stage: y 450–1290 (the drawer front sits at y 1030–1270)
canvas.clearZones: top bar above y 250, right-hand buttons x > 900 in the lower half, bottom UI below y 1560

timing: timeline.json, measured from the full take; every beat keys on a spoken word (wordAt)
continuity: scenes are independent components; the reel cuts between them with no crossfade, and each scene starts in exactly the state the previous one ended (shared positions in src/scenes/shared.tsx); titles fade before each cut
developedFrom: phone-challenge: one connected world instead of three stages; objects change role (button→drawer, card→book, card→task, drawer→step) rather than being replaced; titles never cut mid-word

scenes.name: الافتتاح: الحفظ يصير درجًا ممتلئًا
scenes.purpose: from the first frame: the save button is pressed and becomes a drawer that is already full; its contents grey (unused)
motion: button morphs into the drawer front

scenes.name: فيديو بعد فيديو
scenes.purpose: three saved videos arrive one after another and drop into the drawer as tabs
motion: each drops into the drawer before the next

scenes.name: المحفوظات تصير مؤجلات
scenes.purpose: nothing changed after saving: the drawer closes, pages turn, the list comes back out and each card is stamped «لاحقًا»
motion: calendar pages turn on «بعد / ماذا / تغيّر»
cards rise into a fan on «المحفوظات»

scenes.name: اختر واحدة… وحوّلها
scenes.purpose: one card is chosen (green ring), its stamp peels off, the others go back, and it turns over into a book — a small action

scenes.name: التنفيذ أمامك
scenes.purpose: the book opens and one page is read line by line; the focus card comes out, the phone is moved away, one task starts filling

scenes.name: ليس كل شيء
scenes.purpose: a flood of saved cards; all but one fall away; the one that fits is chosen and started

scenes.name: خطوة واحدة
scenes.purpose: the save button returns, the drawer now holds less, and one step comes out of it; the last question stays
motion: drawer opens with fewer cards on «قبل»
account name in the last 1.6 s

assets.drawings: original SVG in src/art/saved.tsx (+ Phone from reel.tsx, helpers from doodles.tsx/world.tsx); no people, no faces
assets.music: public/music/bed.wav — original, tools/music.py (C–G–Am–F, 96 BPM, seed 11), no samples
assets.voice: ElevenLabs eleven_v4, voice dlGxemPxFMTY7iXagmOj, one full take (generation 53nJKvfS63xfKKzpPaag); Variant B chain on a copy
